caseNameFull: Smith, Co-partners, Trading as Thomson & McKinnon v. Lummus, Tax Assessor
attorneys: Mr. George H. Salley for appellants. Messrs. J. Tom Watson, Attorney General of Florida, and Lawrence A. Truett, Assistant Attorney General, for appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for the want of a substantial federal question. Metropolitan Life Ins. Co. v. New Orleans, 205 U. S. 395; Liverpool Ins. Co. v. Board of Assessors, 221 U. S. 346; Curry v. McCanless, 307 U S. 357, 368.
